ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a long strip-shaped composite conductor, the left front end face is labeled P, and the right end face is labeled Q, indicating finding the resistance between the two end faces P and Q along the length direction of the rod; the rod length is labeled 50 mm. The outer edge of the front-end cross section is a square, with side length labeled 7 mm; in the middle there is a square region labeled Fe, with side length labeled 2 mm, and the surrounding material is labeled Al. Then reason: The two end faces P and Q are the same pair of end faces, and the aluminum frame and the iron core are both connected between P and Q along the same length 50 mm, so they are equivalent to parallel conductors. Take L = 50 mm = 0.05 m. The cross-sectional area of iron A_Fe = (2 mm)^2 = 4 mm^2 = 4 × 10^-6 m^2. The cross-sectional area of aluminum A_Al = (7 mm)^2 - (2 mm)^2 = 49 - 4 = 45 mm^2 = 45 × 10^-6 m^2. Resistance of the aluminum part: R_Al = rho_Al L / A_Al = (2.7 × 10^-8 × 0.05)/(45 × 10^-6) = 3.0 × 10^-5 ohm = 30 micro-ohm. Resistance of the iron part: R_Fe = rho_Fe L / A_Fe = (1.0 × 10^-7 × 0.05)/(4 × 10^-6) = 1.25 × 10^-3 ohm = 1250 micro-ohm. Parallel equivalent: R = (R_Al R_Fe)/(R_Al + R_Fe) = (30 × 1250)/(30 + 1250) micro-ohm = 37500/1280 micro-ohm = 1875/64 micro-ohm.

raw_record.question_text: In an aluminum (Al) bar of square cross section, a square hole is drilled and is filled with iron (Fe) as shown in the figure. The electrical resistivities of Al and Fe are $2.7 \times 10^{-8}\ \Omega\,\text{m}$ and $1.0 \times 10^{-7}\ \Omega\,\text{m}$, respectively. What is the electrical resistance between the two faces P and Q of the composite bar?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the current is to be found between end faces P and Q along the length of the bar; the bar length is marked 50 mm, the square outer cross section is 7 mm by 7 mm, and the iron-filled square hole has side 2 mm. From the text, use rho_Al = 2.7e-8 ohm m and rho_Fe = 1.0e-7 ohm m. Treat the Al frame and the Fe insert as two conductors connected between the same two equipotential end faces, so they are in parallel along the 50 mm length. Use A_Fe = (2 mm)^2 and A_Al = (7 mm)^2 - (2 mm)^2. Compute R_Al = rho_Al L/A_Al and R_Fe = rho_Fe L/A_Fe, then combine by 1/R = 1/R_Al + 1/R_Fe. Convert the final resistance to micro-ohms to obtain 1875/64 micro-ohm.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中显示一根复合长方体导体，端面 P 和 Q 之间的长度标为 50 mm；垂直于电流方向的截面是边长 7 mm 的正方形铝块；其中有一个边长 2 mm 的正方形区域标为 Fe，表示铁填充在铝中的方孔内。

推理：电流从 P 面到 Q 面沿长度方向通过。铝部分和铁部分沿同一长度 50 mm 连接在相同两端面之间，因此它们对总导电相当于并联的截面积贡献。按指定方法先求总 conductance：G = (1/L)(A_Al/rho_Al + A_Fe/rho_Fe)，所以 R = L/(A_Al/rho_Al + A_Fe/rho_Fe)。

总截面积 = 7 mm × 7 mm = 49 mm^2。铁面积 = 2 mm × 2 mm = 4 mm^2。铝面积 = 49 - 4 = 45 mm^2。

换算为 SI：L = 50 mm = 0.05 m；A_Al = 45 × 10^-6 m^2；A_Fe = 4 × 10^-6 m^2。rho_Al = 2.7 × 10^-8 Ω m，rho_Fe = 1.0 × 10^-7 Ω m。

A_Al/rho_Al = (45 × 10^-6)/(2.7 × 10^-8) = 5000/3。A_Fe/rho_Fe = (4 × 10^-6)/(1.0 × 10^-7) = 40。因此分母 = 5000/3 + 40 = 5120/3。

R = 0.05/(5120/3) = 0.15/5120 Ω = 2.9296875 × 10^-5 Ω = 29.296875 μΩ = 1875/64 μΩ。
